error[ZBX-E0527]: there are no AWS credentials to pull from Amazon ECR
  cause  no AWS credentials were found to pull from
         123456789012.dkr.ecr.us-east-1.amazonaws.com
  host   123456789012.dkr.ecr.us-east-1.amazonaws.com
  env    not set
  web    not set
  imds   answered, with no role attached to the instance
  fix    attach an IAM role to this instance, or pass keys in the environment
         or set AWS_ROLE_ARN and AWS_WEB_IDENTITY_TOKEN_FILE for a web identity
         or export the keys of a profile first:   export $(aws configure export-credentials --format env)
  more   zbx explain E0527
  docs   https://zigbox.github.io/zigbox/errors/E0527.html
